_comment: Each publication names its area with a research_area: field in its own index.md. To move a paper, change that one line. To rename an area, edit name below; to reorder them on the page, reorder this list.

areas.name: Pandemic Governance
areas.blurb: What Asian governments could actually do during COVID-19, where that capacity came from, and how publics came to accept restrictions on their own freedom.

areas.name: Insecurity, Uncertainty, and Welfare States
areas.blurb: Why demand for social protection tracks the stability of people's earnings rather than their level, and what that means for social insurance built for salaried careers.

areas.name: Identity and Political Behaviors
areas.blurb: How national identity and pride shape what people want from politics — in trade, in protest, and at the ballot box.

areas.name: Taiwan Politics
areas.blurb: Domestic political conflict and institutional reform in Taiwan.
